quote_boxes.note: Mistranslation: the English says 'Before my father passed on, he claimed...' and 'scions' (descendants) of the people of Tsurumi Island; the Korean states it as '하셨다' without the 'claimed' hedge being faithful is okay, but the speaker's father 'claimed' is rendered as a plain statement of fact. The Korean also drops 'hardly counts for much' nuance into '그렇게 대단한 일은 아니지만', which is acceptable. The main flaw is the loss of 'claimed' (주장했다), presenting the lineage as established.
